xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5427: Markdown Preview renders YAML front matter as body text

plan.title: Markdown Preview renders YAML front matter as body text
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: MarkdownTab passes the raw body to ChatMarkdown, so a leading YAML front matter block renders as an <hr> plus a bold setext paragraph ('title: Mission Control description: ...') above the real heading. Every Mintlify page in features/, configuration/ and reference/ is affected, in every Preview surface (code pane, diff window, dock Changes, editor pane, Docs pane, cockpit dig tabs), because all of them render through MarkdownTab.
narratives.Proposal: Add a pure, dependency-free splitFrontMatter(body) in src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/frontMatter.ts that detects a leading ---/--- block with at least one top-level key line and returns ordered entries (title, description, then source order) plus the remaining content; otherwise it returns the body unchanged. MarkdownTab renders the entries as a compact <dl data-testid="markdown-front-matter"> (keys muted mono, values plain pre-wrap text) above ChatMarkdown, which receives only the content. All MarkdownTab callers inherit the fix. Full detail, value rules and decisions D1-D6 are in .pan/drafts/PAN-5427.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- MDX import/export lines and JSX components (e.g. <ThemedImage .../>) keep rendering as text
- TOML (+++) front matter is not detected
- No full YAML semantics: no anchors, flow collections, escape processing or type coercion
- No new npm dependency (no yaml/js-yaml/gray-matter/remark-frontmatter in the frontend)
- No collapse/hide toggle and no editing of front matter from the Preview
- No change to the Monaco code/editor view, which still shows raw text
- A --- that is not the first line keeps rendering as a horizontal rule
- A fenced leading block with no key line (e.g. ---/prose/---) keeps rendering exactly as today

autoDecisions.summary: Hand-rolled front matter splitter instead of a YAML library
autoDecisions.rationale: The frontend declares no YAML package and the issue asks for values as plain text; lists and maps render as their source text, so a parser adds bundle weight for no visible gain.

autoDecisions.summary: Strip the block only when it closes with --- and has at least one top-level key line
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the issue's 'a body without that leading block renders exactly as today' guarantee for a leading <hr> followed by prose.

autoDecisions.summary: Nested values (lists, maps, block scalars) render as dedented source text with pre-wrap
autoDecisions.rationale: This repo's own front matter (skills, agents) uses lists and nested hooks maps; showing their text is faithful and needs no YAML semantics.

autoDecisions.summary: Only --- closes the block; YAML '...' is not accepted
autoDecisions.rationale: Mintlify, Jekyll and this repo all close with ---.

autoDecisions.summary: The list renders inside the markdown-tab container above ChatMarkdown, so it is part of the EditorPane citable surface
autoDecisions.rationale: Citations quote text and never use line numbers (resolveSelectionCitation.ts), so removing the block from the rendered body shifts nothing.

narrative.Action:
Implement PRD WI-1 exactly. Create src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/frontMatter.ts exporting FrontMatterEntry {key, value}, FrontMatterSplit {entries, content} and splitFrontMatter(body): strip a leading U+FEFF, split on /?
/, require line 0 to be a fence line (exactly '---' after trimming trailing whitespace/), find the next fence line, parse the lines between with the PRD 'Value rules' (top-level key regex ^([A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*)\s*:(?:\s+(.*)|\s*)$; unquote matching quotes; block scalars and list/map continuation lines become dedented text joined by 
; column-0 '#' comments dropped; duplicate keys kept). If there is no closing fence or no key line, return { entries: [], content: body } with body strictly unchanged. Order entries title, description, then source order. content is the lines after the closing fence joined by

items.title: Given the first 8 lines of features/mission-control.mdx, splitFrontMatter returns entries [title: 'Mission Control', description: 'Unified monitoring dashboard for projects, features, and AI agent activity'] and content that contains '# Mission Control' and does not contain 'title:'
Given a body with no closing fence, a body not starting with ---, or a ---/Some prose/--- block, splitFrontMatter returns empty entries and content strictly equal to the input body
Given description before title and a third key icon, splitFrontMatter returns keys in order title, description, icon; CRLF and BOM-prefixed inputs produce the same entries as LF input

Given quoted scalars, a list value (allowed-tools), a nested map (hooks), a '|' block scalar and a column-0 '# note' comment, splitFrontMatter produces unquoted text, '- Bash\n- Read', relative-indented map text, 'line one\nline two', and no entry or value containing '# note'
